lesson-intro.text: Artists call a group of objects a still life. Ours has a mug, a ball and two books, all lit from the top left. Watch where the shadows fall, then set up your own.

mug-rim.text: On the left goes the mug. Draw the oval rim and the smaller oval inside it.

mug-body.text: Add the two sides, the curved bottom, and the handle on the left.

ball.text: Next to it, the ball. Draw its circle in two halves, left then right.

ball-hatch.text: Its lower right is turned from the light. Hatch it with three slanted lines.

book-top.text: On the right, two books. Start with the small one on top: cover, spine, pages.

book-bottom.text: Tuck the big book under it. Draw its strip of cover, its spine and its pages.

shadows-round.text: Every shadow falls to the right. Draw a curved one beside the mug and one beside the ball.

shadow-books.text: The books cast a thin slanted strip. Draw it along the ground.

colors-objects.text: Color the mug red, its edge pink, the drink brown and the ball orange.

colors-books.text: Color the books: blue and purple on top, greens below, cream pages.

lesson-outro.text: A mug, a ball and books, all under one light. That's a real still life, and that's the Forms path done.
